title: CHANGE_TRUST fails with CHANGE_TRUST_CANNOT_DELETE
pattern: A transaction whose CHANGE_TRUST operation fails at apply is still written into the closed ledger: its fee is charged, its sequence number is consumed, and nothing it did is kept. The result carries the operation's code (cannot_delete). Deleting an NRV trustline (limit 0) while an XLM/NRV pool-share trustline still depends on it.

hazards.placement: deleting a trustline a pool-share trustline still uses

facts.says: No operation changed state: the operation meta is empty.
The fee is still charged: the fee source changes in fee processing.
